title: Customer care, cancellation OTP in app

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi, this is Swiggy customer support regarding your cancellation request.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Your refund of 486 rupees will be credited to the original payment method in 3 to 5 days.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: You will get an OTP to confirm the cancellation, please enter it in the app yourself. We do not need it on the call.
